flows:
Navigate to https://www.unitconverters.net/ then Use the locked 320 CSS pixel viewport and scroll vertically only.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
In the Length converter, assert that the complete To value field fits within the 320-pixel viewport.
Enter 1 in From with Meter and Kilometer selected.
Verify 0.001 appears in To without horizontal scrolling.
